operator_correction: Every microsystem should be able to invoke Bellman/Lagrange/Gaussian mechanisms under one umbrella. Agents may build superior planners; the existing microsystem can become a fallback, never a permanent monopoly. Preserve career and purchase wins, enable progressive disclosure, avoid broad instruction bloat.
